beat: House tour: backyard ambience, barbecue and planned pool/second-floor rooms

lines.original: Dhika: Raj... you have a beautiful house....
lines.local: Dhika: Raj, tumhara ghar bahut sundar hai.

lines.original: Raj: glad you like it.... he smiled polite.
lines.local: Raj politely muskuraakar: Achchha laga tumhe pasand aaya.

lines.original: John: smiling at Raj.... you are rich and modest.... rare combination raj...
lines.local: John Raj ko dekhkar: Rich bhi aur modest bhi—rare combination hai Raj!

lines.original: Raj: haha..... Sharmi wouldn't agree with you John... she always say I show off by buying things which I don't need.... I disagree...hehe
lines.local: Raj hanskar: Sharmi tumse agree nahi karegi John. Woh kehti hai main bekaar ki cheezon par paisa udaa kar show-off karta hoon. Main nahi maanta. Hehe.

lines.original: John: haha... that happenes in all houses raj....and he looked at Dhika....
lines.local: John Dhika ki taraf dekhte hue: Haha, har ghar mein hota hai Raj.

lines.original: Sharmi: oh.. no... not like this... come with me.... she pulled John and went and opened the back door....
lines.local: Sharmi: Oh no, aisa nahi! Aao mere saath. Woh John ko kheenchte hue peeche ke darwaze tak le gayi aur khol diya.

lines.original: Looking at them going back.... Raj and Dhika too followed them.... as soon as the door opened.... before even John and Sharmi stepped out, Dhika ran out like a child.....
lines.local: Unhe jaate dekh Raj aur Dhika bhi peeche gaye. Darwaza khulte hi John aur Sharmi ke bahar jaane se pehle Dhika bachchon ki tarah daudkar bahar chali gayi.

lines.original: It was a spacious backyard.... with no garden but a full lawn flooring with golden lights running across over the lawn.... Dhika loved these kind of ambiences. So, looking at it...she ran and stood in the middle of the lawn and looked at the golden lights above.......
lines.local: Backyard kaafi bada tha—bagicha nahi, poora lawn aur uske upar sunehri lights. Dhika ko aisa ambience bahut pasand tha. Woh lawn ke beech jaakar khadi ho gayi aur lights ko upar dekhne lagi.

lines.original: Sharmi on the other hand, was hoping to show John on what raj wasted money on..... but before she opened her mouth, John opened his mouth.... smiling wide.....
lines.local: Sharmi John ko dikhana chahti thi ki Raj ne paisa kahaan waste kiya, magar uske bolne se pehle John muskuraakar bol pada.

lines.original: John: wowwww.... raj, my buddy... you are a genius.....
lines.local: John: Wowww, Raj mere dost, tum genius ho!

lines.original: John saw the full barbeque provision built-in in the patio..
lines.local: John ko patio mein built-in barbecue setup dikh gaya tha.

lines.original: Raj: men always appreciate the beauty... he teased at Sharmi...
lines.local: Raj Sharmi ko chhedte hue: Mard beauty ki kadar karna jaante hain.

lines.original: Dhika: Raj.... what is this ? she pointed at the huge hole dug deep and left out next to the lawn...
lines.local: Dhika: Raj, yeh kya hai? Usne lawn ke paas khode hue bade gehre gaddhe ki taraf ishara kiya.

lines.original: Raj: oh, that is for the pool Dhika...many things in this house in not ready yet......
lines.local: Raj: Oh, yahan pool banega Dhika. Ghar mein abhi bahut saara kaam baaki hai.

lines.original: Raj: even the entire second floor.... I have alloted the floor for all my desired rooms... like a game room, "a lavish shower room"..... pending works to be done.
lines.local: Raj: Poora second floor apni pasand ke rooms ke liye rakha hai—game room, lavish shower room aur doosre kaam abhi pending hain.

lines.original: John: wow Raj.... you know how to live a life...haha... Once all those are ready, I am going to come and live with you.....
lines.local: John: Wah Raj, zindagi jeena tumse seekhein! Sab ban jaayega toh main aakar tumhare saath hi rahunga. Haha.

lines.original: Sharmi: oh, I would like that,,,, she giggled and winked at Dhika and John.... and teasingly looked at Raj.
lines.local: Sharmi: Oh, mujhe toh bahut pasand aayega! Woh hanskar Dhika aur John ko wink kiya aur Raj ko chhedne waali nazar se dekha.

lines.original: Raj smiled at her comment and they all proceed back inside the house....
lines.local: Raj uski baat par muskuraaya; phir sab wapas ghar ke andar chale gaye.
